label: People
description: A row of people with photographs, roles and short biographies.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro text
fields.help: Optional. A sentence or two above the row.

fields.name: columns
fields.label: Columns
fields.help: How many people sit side by side on a wide screen.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Photograph
fields.help: Optional. If the media library has no description for it, the person's name is used instead.

fields.name: bio
fields.label: Short biography
fields.help: A sentence or two. Keep every entry about the same length so the row stays even.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email address
fields.help: Optional. Shown as a link a visitor can write to, so only add it if this person is happy to be contacted directly.
